stem.en: Why are the inner membranes of mitochondria folded into cristae?

text.en: To store water for the cell
To increase the surface area for chemical reactions

feedback.en: Yes. More surface helps energy production.

text.en: To hold the DNA of the nucleus firmly in place in the cell

feedback.en: The nuclear DNA stays in the nucleus.

text.en: To let the mitochondrion move faster through the thick cytoplasm

feedback.en: Folds are not there for movement.

explanation.en: Cristae increase the surface area for chemical reactions and so help energy production.

hints.en: What does a fold add to a membrane?
